lines.zh: 我摆尾两下，就滑出去一截。
lines.en: Two flicks of the tail and I slide ahead.

lines.zh: 水流替我推着走，我不费力。
lines.en: The current does the work; I just steer.

lines.zh: 紫色的鳞在水里像一块光。
lines.en: Violet scales hang in the water like light.
I steer around the kelp; it is crowded there.
I know every ripple in the river sand.

lines.zh: 遇到石头，我一侧身就过去。
lines.en: A stone ahead, so I tilt and pass it.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，怕惊了水面。
lines.en: I swim slowly so as not to stir the surface.
The pond is small but holds three circuits.

lines.zh: 我的影子在沙上跟着我。
lines.en: My shadow follows along the sand beneath.

lines.zh: 下游的水暖些，我往那边去。
lines.en: The water is warmer downstream; I head there.
I paddle with my fins, very gently.

lines.zh: 光从上面漏进来，我躲进去。
lines.en: Light leaks down from above; I hide in it.

lines.zh: 我贴着一块青苔石慢慢挪。
lines.en: I slide past a mossy stone, unhurried.

lines.zh: 水面一动，我就换个方向。
lines.en: The surface stirs, so I change direction.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底的卵石挨过去。
lines.en: I skim low over the pebbles on the bottom.

lines.zh: 一个浪头下来，我顺着推出去了。
lines.en: A ripple comes and carries me along.

lines.zh: 我停在浅处，慢慢摆着尾鳍。
lines.en: I hold in the shallows, sweeping my tail fin.

lines.zh: 气泡一串串升上去，像在数数。
lines.en: Bubbles rise in strings, as if counting something.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，什么也没说。
lines.en: I open my mouth and say nothing at all.
Sun spots shift across my back, warm and kind.
Today I have no plan to swim far.

lines.zh: 我的鳞有点旧了，颜色还亮。
lines.en: My scales are worn but still brightly violet.

lines.zh: 上游有东西掉下来，我听着。
lines.en: Something drops upstream, and I listen for it.

lines.zh: 我数水草，数到第七根就困。
lines.en: I count kelp stalks and grow sleepy at seven.

lines.zh: 有人在岸上走，我不在意。
lines.en: Someone walks the bank; I pay no mind.

lines.zh: 半颗心也没少，今天不错。
lines.en: Not half a heart lost; today is decent.

lines.zh: 我吐出一个小气泡，看它升。
lines.en: I blow one bubble and watch it climb.
Kelp brushes my flank and tickles a little.

lines.zh: 我藏在石缝里，只露半条尾。
lines.en: I tuck into a crevice, tail half showing.

lines.zh: 水里没什么新闻，也很好。
lines.en: No news down here, and that suits me.
You crouched at the bank; I saw you.
Do not put your hand in; it is cold.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的倒影，它在抖。
lines.en: I watch your reflection shiver on the water.

lines.zh: 你挡住光，我的青石暗了。
lines.en: You block the light, and my stone goes dark.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼睛里全是水。
lines.en: I look up at you through a film of water.
Stand back a bit; I frighten easily.

lines.zh: 你在数我的鳞吗，数不清的。
lines.en: Counting my scales? You will lose count.

lines.zh: 竿尖垂着一根线，我看见了。
lines.en: A line hangs from your rod tip; I see it.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里有灯，我记住了。
lines.en: There is a lamp in your eyes; noted.
I swim a little closer, only a little.
Ow! One of my scales has come off.
Blood spreads through the water as red mist.
I dive into the crevice; no more hits.
Fifty points of life, and a chunk is gone.
That blow landed on my flank.
I must flee; fleeing is all I know.
The water bursts up and I tilt sideways.
Do not follow; I will not fight back.
My fin is torn, so I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 我会游开，把这份疼忘掉。
lines.en: I will swim away and forget this pain.
I smell that fish food from here.
What you scattered, is it edible?

lines.zh: 我绕一圈，再决定要不要。
lines.en: I circle once before deciding to take it.

lines.zh: 水面那点碎屑，我不该贪。
lines.en: Those crumbs on the surface; I should not.

lines.zh: 我的嘴已经张开了，没办法。
lines.en: My mouth is already open; nothing to do.
You threw it too near; I dare not go.

lines.zh: 紫色的小东西，最爱这股味。
lines.en: Little violet things love exactly this smell.
One bite, then I swim off again.
River bugs are better than what you hold.
I see it sinking; I must hurry.
You stepped in and I bumped your leg.

lines.zh: 你的靴子搅乱了整片浅滩。
lines.en: Your boots have muddied the whole shallows.
I pull back with every scale raised.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我转了三圈。
lines.en: That bump spun me three full circles.

lines.zh: 我的侧鳍擦到你的靴子。
lines.en: My side fin scraped against your boot.
There is nowhere to dodge; you are huge.
You move, and the whole pool shakes.

lines.zh: 我不是故意的，我只是慢。
lines.en: I did not mean to; I am only slow.
After the bump I dive for deeper water.
Make room, please; I need to pass.
Another violet one circles me slowly.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，鳞光叠在一起。
lines.en: We swim side by side, our scales overlapping.

lines.zh: 它碰我的尾，我也碰回去。
lines.en: It touches my tail; I touch back.

lines.zh: 水草最密的地方，适合产卵。
lines.en: The thickest kelp is the right place for eggs.

lines.zh: 我们绕着那块青石转圈。
lines.en: We circle the mossy stone together.

lines.zh: 我把最好的沙坑让给它。
lines.en: I give it the best hollow in the sand.

lines.zh: 两条紫影在水里合成一条。
lines.en: Two violet shadows merge into one.
It looks at no one else but me.
We guard the eggs and neither of us leaves.
The water has warmed; good for this.

lines.zh: 落在河床上的，都是我的。
lines.en: Whatever settles on the riverbed belongs to me.

lines.zh: 一颗小石子，我含了一下。
lines.en: A small pebble; I hold it a moment.
I nudge it into a crack in the stone.
Someone dropped breadcrumbs, so I eat them.
There is no room in my mouth for two.
This shiny thing comes with me.
Whatever lies on the riverbed stays there.

lines.zh: 这东西在水里泡软了，能吃。
lines.en: It has soaked soft in the water; it is edible.
I root through the sand and find it.
One more and then I move on.
Something moves; time for me to go.

lines.zh: 那是网，我认得网的影子。
lines.en: That is a net; I know its shadow.
You turned, so I turned as well.
That splash is wrong; I hide first.
I fix on the shadow up on the bank.
Someone has put something in the water.
That heavy tread on the bank is no bird.
My heart speeds up; I should flee.
Movement over there, and not a fish.
I fold my fins and drift backwards.
You have not moved; neither will I.
I press to the sand and hold still.
Your shadow is getting closer by the step.
I count your breaths; they are loud.

lines.zh: 你手往上抬，我知道要糟。
lines.en: Your hand lifts, and I know what follows.

lines.zh: 你一站定，我就有路可逃。
lines.en: Once you stand still, I have a way out.
The light on the surface has been blocked.
Move once, and I drop out of sight.

lines.zh: 我全身的鳞都在准备跑。
lines.en: Every scale on me is ready to run.
Three seconds is enough to reach the crack.
I ram your shin once, that is all.
Do not grab me; I can bite.
Eight points of force, straight out of water.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍扫过你的指节。
lines.en: My tail fin rakes across your knuckles.
I only fight back when cornered.
One bite and I run immediately.
This small mouth can still break skin.
Do not put that hand in here.
After the hit I drop to the very bottom.
I cannot beat you, but I will try.

lines.zh: 水里多了一条紫色的影子。
lines.en: One more violet shadow in the water.

lines.zh: 水草一动，我就到了这里。
lines.en: The kelp stirred, and here I am.
The river has a new resident today.
The egg cracked, and I swam out.
I open my eyes and see only water.
The pool is shallow but I can live here.
I flick my tail and the water knows me.
A small fish washes down from upstream.
I enter the water without a splash.
The violet scales light up first.

lines.zh: 水在烧，我从没这样疼过。
lines.en: The water burns; I have never hurt like this.

lines.zh: 我从水里被抛出来，摔在沙上。
lines.en: Thrown out of the water, I hit the dry sand.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的鳃不听使唤。
lines.en: Water floods my gills and they will not work.

lines.zh: 一声闷响，整条河都在震。
lines.en: One muffled blast and the whole river shakes.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿水而来，扎进我背。
lines.en: An arrow crosses the water and finds my back.

lines.zh: 紫色的光，比我的鳞还冷。
lines.en: Violet light, colder than my own scales.
The bottom is empty; I chew at sand.

lines.zh: 电顺着水爬过来，鳞都立了。
lines.en: Current crawls through the water and lifts my scales.

lines.zh: 我离开水，只能拍打空气。
lines.en: Out of the water, I can only beat the air.
